Summary:

In Paris, she won the gold medal in floor exercise, in addition to silver in vault and all-around, and bronze in team events, making her the most decorated Brazilian athlete in Olympic history, whether among men or women. Andrade, who enjoys great popularity in her country, is preparing to compete in the World Championships scheduled to take place from October 19 to 25 in Jakarta, Indonesia.
